{{Quote|Coruscant has not been attacked in over one thousand years!''"<br />"''Then it has a false sense of security.|Lott Dod and Nix Card|<ref name="Heroes" />}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was '''attacked''' at one point over 1000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> That year, during which the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] raged, the attack was recalled by Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in a meeting with fellow senators [[Nix Card/Legends|Nix Card]] and [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]].<ref name="Heroes" />

The senators hoped to trigger a [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|vote]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for the deregulation of [[Bank/Legends|banks]] to earn [[Currency/Legends|money]] for the Federation and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]]. When Card suggested that an attack closer to home could change the minds of some senators to vote for deregulation, Dod realized he was referring to an attack on Coruscant, and responded that Coruscant had not been attacked in over a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]]. Card insisted that fact gave Coruscant's inhabitants a false confidence in their safety and, with Separatist aid, the group went on to successfully orchestrate a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid|bombing]] that ensured the Senate voted for deregulation.<ref name="Heroes" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on Coruscant was alluded to in "[[Heroes on Both Sides]],"<ref name="Heroes" /> the tenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. The episode first aired on [[November 19]], [[2010]]. The accompanying episode guide on [[StarWars.com]] stated that the timeline for the attack coincides with a chronology that places the last [[New Sith Wars|war]] between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in a similar [[Time/Legends|time]], but did not acknowledge that the attack was part of that conflict.<ref name="EPguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>
